title: Interval Taken Off a Keyturn Vehicle Listing that Has Overrun Its Inspection
content:
A vehicle that has run past its inspection has interval taken off the next grant, and how much turns on how long the inspection has been due.

- A vehicle whose inspection mileage credit stands below zero and whose inspection due date is more than 30 calendar days before the handling date has 2000 miles taken off.
- A vehicle whose credit stands below zero with an inspection due date 30 calendar days or fewer before the handling date has 1000 miles taken off.
- Any other vehicle has nothing taken off on this ground, a reduction of 0 miles.

### Points of judgement on a Keyturn Vehicle Listing

*Both conditions of the first two clauses.* Each needs the inspection mileage credit to stand below zero. A vehicle whose credit stands at zero or above has nothing taken off on this ground, however long its inspection due date has passed.

*At the day boundary.* Where the credit stands below zero, an inspection due date exactly 30 calendar days before the handling date takes off 1000 miles; one 31 calendar days before it takes off 2000 miles.

*A due date still ahead.* A vehicle whose inspection due date has not yet been reached falls to the last clause.
